title: Computer science.
bodyText:
(a) Beginning with the 2024-2025 school year, each public charter school that serves elementary, middle, intermediate, or high school students shall offer computer science courses or computer science content at a frequency that allows a student to enroll in a computer science course or receive computer science content at least once while the student is at each of the elementary school, middle or intermediate school, and high school levels.

(b) For the purpose of this section, "offer" shall have the same meaning as in section 302A-323.
bodyHtml:
[§302D-40]  Computer science.  (a)  Beginning with the 2024-2025 school year, each public charter school that serves elementary, middle, intermediate, or high school students shall offer computer science courses or computer science content at a frequency that allows a student to enroll in a computer science course or receive computer science content at least once while the student is at each of the elementary school, middle or intermediate school, and high school levels.

     (b)  For the purpose of this section, "offer" shall have the same meaning as in section 302A-323. [L 2021, c 158, §4]
